# awscc_redshift_snapshot (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Redshift::Snapshot. Creates a manual snapshot of the specified cluster. The cluster must be in the available state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_identifier` (String) The cluster identifier for which you want a snapshot.
- `snapshot_identifier` (String) A unique identifier for the snapshot that you are requesting. This identifier must be unique for all snapshots within the Amazon Web Services account.

### Optional

- `manual_snapshot_retention_period` (Number) The number of days that a manual snapshot is retained. If the value is -1, the manual snapshot is retained indefinitely. The value must be either -1 or an integer between 1 and 3653.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of tag instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `availability_zone` (String) The Availability Zone in which the cluster was created.
- `cluster_create_time` (String) The time (UTC) when the cluster was originally created.
- `cluster_version` (String) The version ID of the Amazon Redshift engine that is running on the cluster.
- `db_name` (String) The name of the database that was created when the cluster was created.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) If true, the data in the snapshot is encrypted at rest.
- `encrypted_with_hsm` (Boolean) A boolean that indicates whether the snapshot data is encrypted using the HSM keys of the source cluster.
- `engine_full_version` (String) The engine full version of the cluster at the time the snapshot was taken.
- `enhanced_vpc_routing` (Boolean) An option that specifies whether to create the cluster with enhanced VPC routing enabled.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `kms_key_id` (String) The Key Management Service (KMS) key ID of the encryption key that was used to encrypt data in the cluster from which the snapshot was taken.
- `maintenance_track_name` (String) The name of the maintenance track for the snapshot.
- `master_username` (String) The admin user name for the cluster.
- `node_type` (String) The node type that the cluster is provisioned with.
- `number_of_nodes` (Number) The number of nodes in the cluster.
- `owner_account` (String) The Amazon Web Services account that owns the snapshot.
- `port` (Number) The port that the cluster is listening on.
- `snapshot_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot.
- `snapshot_create_time` (String) The time (in UTC format) when Amazon Redshift began the snapshot.
- `snapshot_type` (String) The snapshot type. Snapshots created using CreateClusterSnapshot and CopyClusterSnapshot are of type manual.
- `status` (String) The snapshot status. The value of the status depends on the API operation used: CreateClusterSnapshot and CopyClusterSnapshot returns status as creating. DescribeClusterSnapshots returns status as creating, available, final snapshot, or failed. DeleteClusterSnapshot returns status as deleted.
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC identifier of the cluster if the snapshot is from a cluster in a VPC.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_redshift_snapshot.example
  identity = {
    snapshot_arn = "snapshot_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `snapshot_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_redshift_snapshot.example
  id = "snapshot_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_redshift_snapshot.example "snapshot_arn"
```
